notes.title: Release Date Set Back
notes.notes:
Due to a bit of an overlook, the Steam release date of Going Nowhere: The Dream will be pushed back. The release date will tentatively be set to the 23rd of November but it will likely take longer. There will be another announcement when the game goes live so please follow the Steam page!

As an apology the one week launch discount will increase to 15%, lowering the launch price of the game to $6.80.

Going Nowhere: The Dream will still be available on other distributors on the 20th of November as planned. Check http://www.stephanhaldaman.com/goingnowherethedream.html for more information.
